tree.heading: Board of Directors.—
tree.text: The board of directors and the responsibilities of the board are as provided in the articles of incorporation or bylaws.

tree.heading: Officers.—
tree.text: The officers and the election of officers are as provided in the articles of incorporation or bylaws.

tree.heading: Nondiscrimination.—
tree.text: The requirements for holding office in the corporation may not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, or national origin.
